## Checks / 检查

- [ ] Data is in the correct family and stage. / 数据分类与审核目录正确。
- [ ] Stable IDs are preserved; no unsupported names or claims. / 保留 ID，无杜撰名称或定性。
- [ ] I can contribute my own data under CC0 and code/docs under MIT. / 有权按对应许可证贡献。
- [ ] Copied third-party material has compatible permission evidence. / 复制的第三方内容有兼容授权证明。
- [ ] Validation, formatting, tests and build pass. / 校验、格式、测试、构建通过。
- [ ] Warnings are explained above. / 已解释警告。

Maintainer review / 维护者审核:

- [ ] A human checked accuracy, context, privacy and reuse rights before approval.
  / 已人工核对准确性、语境、隐私和再利用权利。
